description: A painted scene of a seated man in a silver embroidered robe and a turban with a white plume, wearing pearl necklaces, beside a seated woman in a red and gold veil with heavy jewellery, on a patterned rug in a dim palace room under an ornate canopy. Attendants on both sides hold silver trays and pour gold coins and pearls over the couple, with lamps lit in the background. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
